messages:
sara_sales: Quick intake — ACME Media asks for a temporary rate uplift for a 10-day campaign. They want ~5x their daily token allowance starting tomorrow. Can support review fraud risk before we approve?

mike_support: Thanks. Can you paste org_id and a short description of expected traffic patterns? Any new API keys or IP ranges?

sara_sales: org_id: org-acme-9982. They say traffic will be concentrated 10am-6pm PST, mostly short generation calls (prompt 50-150 tokens). New campaign will use a single new API key. No new IPs reported yet.

nina_security: Flagging for fraud screening. Quick checks: 1) is the new API key tied to an existing user or a freshly provisioned account? 2) geo distribution of incoming requests, 3) error/invalid-auth spike, 4) rapid token churn across many prompts.

mike_support: I pulled last 7 days for org-acme-9982 — baseline is ~1.2M tokens/day. There's a small uptick last 48h ~1.6M but nothing crazy. New key was created 6h ago. IPs so far: 3 distinct ranges, all from CDNs (us-west). No invalid-auth spikes.

nina_security: New key creation + sudden planned 5x uplift = medium risk. Ask customer for proof-of-campaign (landing page, ad account, or campaign manager). Also recommend temporary uplift with strict guardrails: time-limited, capped per-minute rate, and sampling enabled for eval.

mike_support: Proposed operational plan: 1) grant provisional uplift: 5x daily quota, expires in 10 days, 2) set per-second and per-minute soft caps (e.g., burst=50 req/min, sustained=10 req/min), 3) enable sampling logs at 5% and forward to security for realtime scoring, 4) scheduled check in after 24h and 72h. Approve this if security OK.

sara_sales: Customer OK with proof-of-campaign (shared link) — sending now. They accept the guardrails.

nina_security: I'll run fraud signals against sampled traffic. If we see: high prompt reuse across many user_ids, impossible output patterns, or TOR exit nodes, we revoke immediately. Otherwise proceed.

devon_product: Heads-up — this pattern keeps coming up. Can we create a product backlog item for a formal "provisional uplift" flow (sales/support -> product) so we can automate guardrails? Acceptance criteria I suggest: 1) UI to request provisional uplift tied to org and API key, 2) automatic expiration and audit log, 3) configurable soft caps (per-sec/per-min/day), 4) linkage to anomaly detector that auto-rolls back, 5) generated justification stored for onboarding to billing.

mike_support: Agree. For this case, I'll do manual uplift and file a PM ticket with the customer artifacts + logs. ops-bot, please create a support ticket and link to product backlog.

ops-bot: Ticket SUP-3124 created by mike_support for org-acme-9982. Linked to backlog epic PROD-846 (provisional-uplifts).

devon_product: Thanks — I'll owner the PROD-846 epic. For the backlog item, add launch criteria: - successful automated revoke in a staged test, - telemetry dashboards for token delta and fraud score, - playbook doc for support. Also estimate: 3 sprints for an MVP (backend + minimal UI), 1 sprint for e2e tests and docs.

nina_security: For the manual uplift, security checklist before we flip: 1) verified proof-of-campaign, 2) new key only tied to the campaign, 3) logging & sampling enabled, 4) contact info for campaign ops. If any are missing hold uplift.

mike_support: Checklist ticked. I'm applying provisional uplift now. Command I ran: 
```
# internal tool
rictl quota adjust --org org-acme-9982 --key key-xy12 --multiplier 5 --expires 2026-04-05T23:59:00Z --soft-rate 10/m --burst 50/m --sampling 5%
```

mike_support: Uplift applied. Monitoring dashboards set. I'll ping if any anomaly.

sara_sales: Thanks all — I'll notify ACME and share the contact for campaign ops.

nina_security: I'll monitor for 24h and report. If anything suspicious, we'll revoke and notify sales/support. :shield:

devon_product: Leaving a note in PROD-846 with customer details and the acceptance criteria above. Assigning to me and adding support + security as reviewers.

mike_support: Closing thread for now. Will update SUP-3124 with 24h status. :white_check_mark:
